## Platform description

MetaStation provides:
- A native trading account (spot and perpetuals, gasless execution) created at registration
- Multi-exchange support: Binance, ByBit, KuCoin via API keys
- Funding from 35+ blockchain networks
- Social copy trading marketplace (follow providers, become a provider)
- Webhook trading automation (JSON and natural language signals)
- Telegram-to-Trade signal execution
- Advanced orders: up to 10 Take Profits, Trailing Stop Loss, Stop Loss X (SLX)
